rewrites.comment: BrowserRouter serves /inbox, /t/:id and the rest from the client, so every deep link falls back to index.html. /api and /assets are excluded: an API 404 must stay a 404, and a missing hashed bundle must not silently return HTML.

crons.comment: Settlement also runs opportunistically on API traffic. This is the backstop for a deployment nobody is using, and Hobby allows one run per day.
